d:
Enjoy the melodious duet “Main Kunwari Albeli” from the 1985 film Babu, starring the evergreen Rajesh Khanna and graceful Hema Malini. This delightful romantic number features the golden voices of Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle, composed with beautiful rhythm and charm that define the 80s Bollywood era.
